data.name: Elemental Immunity
data.description: Choose an elemental damage type (Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire): Immune to that type. Can be taken again, each time, choose a different element, and increase RP cost by 1. If you have Fire Immunity and Cold Vulnerability, or if you have Cold Immunity and Fire Vulnerability, you gain the fire subtype, or the cold subtype, respectively.
